title: Fediverse Scraper input
description: Point it at Mastodon or Bluesky accounts, hashtags or posts. Platform is detected per target, so you can mix both networks in one run.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description:
What to scrape, one entry per line. The platform is detected automatically.

Mastodon: `@user@instance`, `#hashtag@instance`, a profile URL (`https://mastodon.social/@Gargron`), or a post permalink. Works on any Mastodon instance, not just mastodon.social.

Bluesky: a handle (`bsky.app`, `alice.bsky.social`), a `did:plc:...`, a profile or post URL (`https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app`), or an `at://` URI. People search: `bsky:actors:climate`.

Not supported: Bluesky keyword/hashtag search. Bluesky refuses unauthenticated search requests from datacenter IPs and this Actor never asks for your password. Use a Mastodon hashtag target instead.

mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: `both` (default) returns a profile row for every account target plus post rows for everything. `profiles` returns account rows only - for a hashtag target, that means the accounts posting under it. `posts` returns post rows only.

maxPostsPerTarget.title: Max posts per target
maxPostsPerTarget.description: Upper bound on post rows collected for each target. Pagination stops as soon as this is reached, so a lower number is a cheaper, faster run. Raise it for a full backfill.

since.title: Only posts since
since.description: Optional ISO date (`2026-01-01`) or timestamp. Posts older than this are skipped and pagination stops early once the feed passes the cut-off. Leave empty for no date limit.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Include posts that are replies to someone else. Off by default, because most users want original posts.

includeReposts.title: Include boosts / reposts
includeReposts.description: Include content the account boosted (Mastodon) or reposted (Bluesky) rather than wrote. Such rows are flagged with `isRepost: true` and credited to the original author.

resolveMedia.title: Include media
resolveMedia.description: Populate the `media` array with image, video and link-card URLs plus their alt text. Turn off for a smaller, text-only dataset.

includeRaw.title: Include raw API response
includeRaw.description: Attach the untouched API object to every row as `raw`. Useful when you need a field this Actor does not normalize; makes the dataset several times larger.

defaultMastodonInstance.title: Default Mastodon instance
defaultMastodonInstance.description: Instance used for targets written without one, such as a bare `#hashtag`.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent targets
maxConcurrency.description: How many targets to work on at once. Requests to any single server are paced regardless, to stay well inside published rate limits.
